sentence: A shared shift signup list where each shift shows how many spots are open and members tap to join or leave a shift.
use_when: Organizing helpers for a party or event in time slots
Filling door, music or cleanup shifts with a set number of people each
Seeing which shifts still need people
Letting people sign up and drop out themselves
dont_use_when: Picking one date or option that works for everyone (use a poll)
Splitting costs or tracking who owes what
Assigning tasks to specific people by a leader
Planning a full calendar with reminders
